derivation.baseline: base + pinned male-young target as declared artist baseline, not an ethnicity or identity inference
derivation.retained_group: body only; all source helper, joint, rig and genital-helper groups excluded
derivation.arm_weights: For each side sum weights in upperarm01 descendants (24bones), divide by sum of ALL source vertex weights; rounding normalization explicitly applied.
derivation.hand_weights: For each side sum wrist descendants (20bones), same all-weight denominator.
derivation.side_labels: Official L is positive X, R negative X; original side labels preserved.
derivation.landmarks: Means of pinned mhskel joint source-index arrays after applying same baseline and normalization; crown chosen from BODY maximum Y, chin alias is source991, source delta means scaled by SAME height.
derivation.head_frame_note: BODY_HEAD_FRAME uses actual young crown/chin and head depth center; separate BODY_BASE_HEAD_FRAME retains legacy raw base frame for provenance.
derivation.forearm_weights: For each side sum exact lowerarm01 descendants (22bones including wrist/hands/fingers), divide by the same ALL official source vertex-weight sum; round to10decimals. BODY_FOREARM_CHAIN_BONES explicitly records included names.
